meta.title: In-scope cabinet offices, South Korea, 1988-02-25 to 1998-02-27
meta.scope: 국무총리 and every office whose head held 국무위원 status. Offices checked and found not to carry 국무위원 status are included with in_scope false.

window.note: 1998-02-25 to 1998-02-27 overlaps offices.json on purpose. Offices that continue past 1998-02-27 are cut at the window end here.

conventions: from = first day under that name (effective date under the 부칙, fixed by the 직제 decree where the 부칙 says so) or the window start
to = last day under that name (day before the next effective date) or the window end
is_kukmuwiwon = the governing text says the head is a 국무위원 (행정각부 제29조②, express clauses for 원·처, 제17조② for 부총리, 제18조① for 정무장관)
legal_basis[].source and source_ids point to ids in 'sources' (URL, access time from shell `date`, snapshot path, sha256)
archives[] records the 국가기록원 existence period as an independent second source and says whether it agrees
Rule check. No two in-scope offices that existed on the same day share a lineage key (checked by the build script)

lineages.hints: 헌법 제10호 took effect 1988-02-25 (부칙 제1조). 제86조① PM appointed with Assembly consent, same rule as 헌법 제9호. 부칙 제4조① deems officials in office on 1988-02-25 appointed under the new constitution, so the 전두환-era PM in office on 1988-02-24 needs no new appointment to continue. The PM 직무대행 order under 정부조직법 제22조 is the 부총리 (경제기획원장관) to 1990-12-26, then 경제기획원장관 부총리 and 통일원장관 부총리 in that order to 1994-12-22, then 재정경제원장관 부총리 and 통일원장관 부총리 from 1994-12-23. Acting PMs are not spells. None of the laws read here provides for a PM 서리, so 서리 periods come from roster sources.

New key. Every 경제기획원장관 held the 부총리 title ex officio (제17조③, 1인 to 1990-12-26, first of two from 1990-12-27). Abolished when 법률 제4831호's provisions took effect on 1994-12-23 with 대통령령 제14438호, which repealed 경제기획원직제, so the last day is 1994-12-22. 부칙 제2조① hands 경제기획원장관 and 재무부장관 duties to 재정경제원장관. Coexisted with 재무부 for its whole life. Also carried the budget function, which later becomes the budget lineage.

재무부 to 1994-12-22, then 재정경제원 from 1994-12-23 (법률 제4831호, 대통령령 제14438호 repealed 재무부와그소속기관직제). 재무부장관 was never 부총리. 부총리 겸 재정경제원장관 from 1994-12-23 to 1998-02-27. Branch choice. Finance continues from 재무부 because 재무부's statutory list (제32조①, 화폐·금융·국채·정부회계·내국세제·관세·외국환·대외경제협력·국유재산·전매) is what 재정경제부 carries after 1998 (제27조①), while 경제기획원's budget function went to the budget lineage in 1998. Both ministries are named predecessors in 부칙 제2조①, and the act rewrote 경제기획원's article (제23조) as 재정경제원, so the choice rests on function, not text. To follow the economic 부총리, read epb then finance. The 재정경제원 holdover spell to 1998-02-27 is already in finance.verified.json.

국토통일원 to 1990-12-26, 통일원 from 1990-12-27 (법률 제4268호, effective on promulgation, 부칙 제2조 deems staff transferred). 국토통일원장관 was not 부총리. 부총리 겸 통일원장관 from 1990-12-27 to 1998-02-27. The laws are silent on whether the sitting minister needed a new appointment at the rename.

New key. 총무처 (제24조③, 장관은 국무위원으로 보하고) for the whole window. Merged with 내무부 into 행정자치부 on 1998-02-28 (법률 제5529호 부칙 제3조① 표). Its 1998 holdover spell is filed under interior in interior.verified.json and needs the override.
내무부 for the whole window, name unchanged. Coexisted with 총무처 (general_affairs) throughout.
과학기술처 (제25조②) for the whole window. Becomes 과학기술부 on 1998-02-28.

No 국무위원 office before 1990-01-03 (환경청 under 보건사회부, 청장 정무직). 환경처 from 1990-01-03 (법률 제4183호 부칙 제1조 단서 with 환경처직제 대통령령 제12899호, which repealed 환경청직제) to 1994-12-22. The 1989 text reads '장관은 국무위원으로 하고'. 환경부 (행정각부) from 1994-12-23.

New key. 공보처 from 1990-01-03 (법률 제4183호 부칙 제1조 단서, 공보처직제 대통령령 제12898호) to 1998-02-27. Took 문화공보부's 홍보·여론조사·언론·보도·방송 사무 (부칙 제2조). Broadcasting left its duty list on 1994-12-23. Abolished 1998-02-28, duties split between 문화관광부 and the PM's 공보실 (not 국무위원), so the lineage ends. Before 1990-01-03 the 공보 portfolio sat inside 문화공보부 (culture). Its 1998 holdover spell is filed under culture in culture.verified.json and needs the override.

문화공보부 to 1990-01-02, 문화부 1990-01-03 to 1993-03-05, 문화체육부 from 1993-03-06. The 1990-01-03 split follows 법률 제4183호 부칙 제1조 단서 and 문화부직제 (대통령령 제12895호, which repealed 문화공보부직제). The 1993-03-06 merger with 체육청소년부 follows 법률 제4541호 and 대통령령 제13869호. Branch choice. 문화공보부 and 문화부 stay in culture because 문화부 replaced 문화공보부 in the 행정각부 list and leads to 문화체육부 and 문화관광부, while 공보처 (public_info) was a new 처 with no 국무위원 successor. Tourism moved in from 교통부 on 1994-12-23.

New key. 체육부 to 1990-12-26, 체육청소년부 1990-12-27 to 1993-03-05 (rename by 법률 제4268호 on promulgation). 국가기록원 dates the rename 1991-02-01, the day 대통령령 제13284호 renamed the 직제, whose own 개정이유 cites the 1990-12-27 law. Merged into 문화체육부 on 1993-03-06. 부칙 제2조 of 법률 제4541호 excludes 정무직 from the staff transfer.
외무부 for the whole window. Becomes 외교통상부 on 1998-02-28.
법무부 for the whole window, unchanged.
국방부 for the whole window, unchanged.
문교부 to 1990-12-26, 교육부 from 1990-12-27 (법률 제4268호 on promulgation, 부칙 제2조 and 제10조).
농림수산부 to 1996-08-07, 농림부 from 1996-08-08 (법률 제5153호 부칙 제1조 ties the date to the 해양수산부 직제, 대통령령 제15135호, and 농림부와그소속기관직제 대통령령 제15134호 took effect the same day). Fisheries went to 해양수산부.

상공부 to 1993-03-05, 상공자원부 1993-03-06 to 1994-12-22, 통상산업부 from 1994-12-23. The 1993 merger of 상공부 and 동력자원부 follows 법률 제4541호 and 대통령령 제13870호, which repealed both 직제. Branch choice. Industry continues from 상공부 because the act retitled 상공부's article (제37조) and deleted 동력자원부's (제37조의2).
New key. 동력자원부 (제37조의2, 동력과 지하자원) to 1993-03-05, then merged into 상공자원부 (industry). No later 국무위원 office continues it on its own within the window.

건설부 to 1994-12-22, 건설교통부 from 1994-12-23 (법률 제4831호, 대통령령 제14447호 repealed both 직제). Branch choice. Land continues from 건설부 because 건설교통부's duty list opens with 건설부's 국토 functions and leads to 국토해양부 and 국토교통부. 해사 moved to 해양수산부 on 1996-08-08.
New key. 교통부 (육운·항공·해사와 관광) to 1994-12-22, then merged into 건설교통부 (land). Tourism went to 문화체육부 at the merger.
보건사회부 to 1994-12-22, 보건복지부 from 1994-12-23 (법률 제4831호, 대통령령 제14446호).
노동부 for the whole window, unchanged.
체신부 to 1994-12-22, 정보통신부 from 1994-12-23 (법률 제4831호, 대통령령 제14445호).
해양수산부 from 1996-08-08 (법률 제5153호, 대통령령 제15135호). No 국무위원 predecessor, so the lineage starts on that day.

정무장관(제1) for the whole window. 정부조직법 제18조 allows two 정무장관 (원·부·처의 장관이 아닌 국무위원). 정무장관실직제 제2조 names them (제1) and (제2). From 1994-11-26 제2조② gives (제1) the 국회·정당 등 정치관련사무. Abolished 1998-02-28. The later 특임장관 in this key is linked by office type, not by legal succession. The (제2) post is in gender.

정무장관(제2) for the whole window. Women's policy is tied to the post in decree texts from 1989-09-21 (대통령령 제12809호 개정이유), formally assigned on 1994-11-26 (제2조②, 대통령령 제14417호), and named in 여성발전기본법시행령 from 1996-07-01. On 1998-02-28 법률 제5529호 handed those duties to 여성특별위원회 (not 국무위원), which became 여성부 on 2001-01-29. Until 1989-09-21 the 직제 (제5조) suspended the (제2)실 three months after the post fell vacant, and 대통령령 제11239호 (1983-10-07) suspended it outright on that day, so the post may have been empty on 1988-02-25 and at other times. The portfolio of a (제2) holder before 1989-09-21 must come from roster sources. Its 1998 holdover spell is filed under special in special.verified.json and needs the override.

keys_without_offices.why: Budget sat inside 경제기획원 (epb) to 1994-12-22 and 재정경제원 (finance) from 1994-12-23. No separate office in the window.
중소기업청 (1996-02-09 onward) head was not a 국무위원.
국가보훈처 head was 장관급 but not a 국무위원 (제28조②, 제13조①).

holdovers_1988.note: The office structure on 1988-02-24 and on 1988-02-25 is the same (법률 제3854호 version, in force 1987-01-01 to 1989-12-29 with no amendment listed by law.go.kr in between). Every 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25 holds one of the offices below from that day. 헌법 제10호 부칙 제4조① deems officials in office on 1988-02-25 appointed under the new constitution. Appointment rules for the PM (Assembly consent) and 국무위원 (PM's recommendation) are the same in 헌법 제9호 and 제10호, so the 단서 of 부칙 제4조① does not apply to them.

law.go.kr artifact, shows the pre-1998 text, not evidence

uncertainties: 체육청소년부 start. The statute (법률 제4268호) took effect 1990-12-27. 국가기록원 dates the rename 1991-02-01, the day the 직제 was renamed (대통령령 제13284호). Appointment notices may use either name in January 1991. The inventory uses 1990-12-27.

정무장관(제2) portfolio before 1989-09-21. No decree text read here names its portfolio before 대통령령 제12809호 (1989-09-21). The office is the same legal post throughout, so the gender key covers any holder from 1988-02-25, but the roster should record the holder's actual portfolio.

정무장관 vacancies. Until 1989-09-21 정무장관실직제 제5조 suspended the (제2)실 three months after the post fell vacant, and 부칙② of 대통령령 제11239호 suspended the (제2)실 on 1983-10-07. The inventory does not establish whether a (제2) minister was in office on 1988-02-24 or 1988-02-25. Gaps in either 정무장관 post must come from the roster.
Deputy PM title. 제17조① reads '둘 수 있다'. The inventory gives the legal availability of each title. Whether each minister was styled 부총리 must come from appointment records.

Branch choices for mergers (finance from 재무부 rather than 경제기획원, culture from 문화부, industry from 상공부, land from 건설부) rest on statutory functions and article structure as explained in each lineage hint. They are researcher-reviewable choices, not facts of law.

국가기록원 end dates mix two conventions (last day, or the abolition day). The archives check field says which applies. Its 기관연혁 prose has some slips (for example it cites 법률 제3854호 for the 1985 국가보훈처 change) and is used only as corroboration of dates.
No news source was consulted for these legal dates. Each date rests on the statute, the separate 직제 decree that fixed the effective date, and the 국가기록원 catalogue.
The first run of fetch_archives_organ.py matched sub-units by mistake and saved 1,478 extra pages. They were moved, not deleted, to web/archives_organ/_stale_first_run/ and are not used.
